types.name: operator
types.description:
The operator used to check whether the buy rule applies on a cart.
For example, `eq` means that the cart's value for the specified attribute
must match the specified value.

types.name: description
types.description: The description of the promotion rule.

types.name: attribute
types.description: The attribute to compare against when checking whether a promotion can be applied on a cart.

types.name: values
types.description: The value to compare against when checking whether a promotion can be applied on a cart.
